title: Understanding F1 Score
text: The F1 score is a measure of a test's accuracy. It considers both precision and recall to compute the score. The F1 score is the harmonic mean of precision and recall.

title: Effect of Threshold on Classification
text: Changing the threshold in a classification model can affect which instances are classified as positive or negative, thus affecting precision and recall.

title: Calculating Precision and Recall
text: Precision is the number of true positive results divided by the number of all positive results, including those not identified correctly. Recall is the number of true positive results divided by the number of positives that should have been retrieved.
